title: asset.library@1
description: A library source: search {words, kind, size_m, license, limit} gives rows of an online library's catalog (id, name, kind, license {id, terms, shareable, credit}, size in m where the library states one, triangles, a thumbnail path and the library's own URL), and fetch {id} names an asset's file, its sidecars, its license and its upstream, read from the library's own record. The hub makes every call and downloads every byte.
